python3 - <<'CHECK'
from pathlib import Path
import re
source=Path('skills/cloudflare-doctor/SKILL.md').read_text().splitlines()
for name in ['no-cost-tradeoff','no-public-route-cost-gate','no-source-basis']:
    patch=Path('evals/ablations/'+name+'.patch').read_text().splitlines()
    pos=0
    while pos<len(patch):
        m=re.fullmatch(r'@@ -(\d+),(\d+) \+(\d+),(\d+) @@',patch[pos]); assert m, patch[pos]
        start,count=int(m[1]),int(m[2]); pos+=1; old=[]
        while pos<len(patch) and not patch[pos].startswith('@@'):
            assert patch[pos].startswith('-'); old.append(patch[pos][1:]); pos+=1
        assert len(old)==count,(name,len(old),count)
        assert source[start-1:start-1+count]==old,(name,start)
    print(name, 'all hunk positions/content match current skill')
CHECK
